title: On the Failure of a Universal Linear Representation Hypothesis in Deep Neural Networks

contributions.purpose: 用 VC 维给出线性可表示性的组合不可能界
contributions.mechanism: Cover 二分定理+VC 维分析线性可分概念占比
contributions.evaluation: 定理1 线性可分概念比例 ρ(n,d)=O(n^d/2^n);d=O(log n) 时 (1-o(1)) 概念不可线性分(纯理论)
contributions.source_quote: Combinatorial Analysis: Sharp VC-dimension bounds showing exponential separation between concept complexity and linear representability

contributions.purpose: 用电路复杂度证明深度分离与线性中间表征不相容
contributions.mechanism: 深度分离下界论证+显式代数构造(XOR/parity 等非线性概念族)
contributions.evaluation: 定性:depth-separated 函数无指数维不能有线性中间表征;XOR 凸包相交给出几何反例(无数字实验)
contributions.source_quote: Circuit Complexity: Rigorous depth-separation arguments proving incompatibility with known lower bounds

contributions.purpose: 给出信息论/测度论下界并划定近似成立条件
contributions.mechanism: 表征维度信息论下界+随机概念对的测度论 generic failure
contributions.evaluation: 定性负结果 + 声称 reproducible experiments(附录B synthetic/naturalistic/LM 实验)确认预测
contributions.source_quote: Measure Theory: Generic failure results for random concept-representation pairs

notes: 整篇为负结果论文:证明通用线性表征假设(LRH)不可能普遍成立,同时划出近似成立条件。数据红旗:abstract 与贡献#6 明确宣称'reproducible experiments confirming theoretical predictions'、正文第9节称附录B有 synthetic/naturalistic/language model 实验,但 checklist reproducibility 答 NA'The paper is focusing on theory and does not include experiments',open access 答'answerNA'(LaTeX 占位符残留、破坏格式)、experimental settings 答 NA——自曝'有实验'与'无实验'相互矛盾,疑似实证部分为占位/未真正开展。多数主定理正文只写'Proof. See Appendix A'。无自声明 extend/adapt/replace 句(provenance 空)。贡献以其 6 条列表归并为 3 组四元组。
